import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter out correlated features (keep only one from each pair)
    correlated_pairs = {
        ('TOF14B', 'HII18'), ('IRE15B', 'PRX1'), ('DZLO16', 'ANK11B'),
        ('MGA13B', 'NVV13B'), ('RWA8B', 'PRX1'), ('SXO17', 'KSQH15'),
        ('VKO13B', 'PRX1'), ('ANK11B', 'NVV13B'), ('MGA13B', 'ANK11B'),
        ('DWZT15', 'ANK11B'), ('DZLO16', 'NVV13B'), ('DWZT15', 'NVV13B'),
        ('PRX1', 'FMQI13L'), ('RWA8B', 'IRE15B'), ('MGA13B', 'DWZT15'),
        ('TOF14B', 'SXO17'), ('TOF14B', 'KSQH15'), ('ZQYC5', 'PRX1'),
        ('TYSW1', 'PRX1'), ('DZLO16', 'OGO8')
    }
    
    keep_ids = set(feats.ids)
    for a, b in correlated_pairs:
        if a in keep_ids and b in keep_ids:
            # Keep the one with higher mean_y1-mean_y0
            idx_a = feats.column(a)
            idx_b = feats.column(b)
            mean_a = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx_a]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx_a])
            mean_b = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx_b]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx_b])
            if abs(mean_a) < abs(mean_b):
                keep_ids.remove(a)
            else:
                keep_ids.remove(b)
    
    # Compute effect sizes and select top candidates
    effects = []
    for fid in keep_ids:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        mean_diff = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx])
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx], feats.x[feats.y==0, idx]).statistic
        effects.append((fid, abs(mean_diff), abs(t_stat)))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)
    
    # Select drivers based on effect size (at most 4 as per checker report)
    drivers = [fid for fid, _, _ in effects[:4] if abs(_)>0.5]
    
    # If no strong drivers, return empty design
    if not drivers:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build logistic regression features
    columns = []
    products = []
    loadings = {}
    
    # Add main effects
    columns.extend(drivers)
    for fid in drivers:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        mean_diff = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx])
        loadings[fid] = mean_diff
    
    # Add interaction terms for pairs of drivers
    for i in range(len(drivers)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(drivers)):
            a, b = drivers[i], drivers[j]
            products.append((a, b))
    
    # Ensure we don't include too many features
    if len(columns) > 10:
        columns = columns[:10]
    if len(products) > 10:
        products = products[:10]
        
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=tuple(columns), products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
